dialogues.speaker: "Weary Inn" Announcement
dialogues.text: "Welcome to the Weary Inn! Good eats and sweet sleeps!"

dialogues.speaker: "Weary Inn" Announcement
dialogues.text: "Please place your orders at the bar with Manager Chanca. If you require lodging, please enter the inn."

dialogues.speaker: "Weary Inn" Introduction
dialogues.text: "As the designated lodging for contestants in the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, our establishment has over a century of history. The quality of all of our services is guaranteed!"

dialogues.speaker: "Weary Inn" Introduction
dialogues.text: "All food and lodging provided by our Inn will be free of charge during the preparations for the Pilgrimage! We'll provide room service and scrumptious treats until your satisfaction is complete!"

dialogues.speaker: "Weary Inn" Introduction
dialogues.text: "It's said that if a contestant stays in the same room that legendary contestants once slept in, there's a chance they'll get really lucky, and be super on-form during the competition! Even adventurers are likely to see impressive results, reaping massive rewards!"

dialogues.speaker: "Weary Inn" Introduction
dialogues.text: "Of course, rooms are randomly assigned, and we do not accept reservations for specific rooms, no matter the price. Transferring rooms to other parties is prohibited as well."

dialogues.speaker: "Weary Inn" Introduction
dialogues.text: "Please check in calmly and rest well. We hope you will be all fired up and motivated to the max every day when you awake!"

dialogues.speaker: "Weary Inn" Announcement
dialogues.text: "The preliminary rounds of the 243rd 'Inferno Stomach Supremo' competition will be held in each tribe's territory! The Supreme Supremo will be determined when the winners of each tribe show off and show down at our shop!"

dialogues.speaker: "Weary Inn" Announcement
dialogues.text: "The highlights of this year have already been revealed: The Pre-Eminent Pacal, leader of the Children of Echoes, will emerge from his exile and return to write the next chapter of his legendary '71 servings of Glittering Gemstones' feat of five years ago!"

dialogues.speaker: "Weary Inn" Announcement
dialogues.text: "Perhaps it's due to the arrival of a dark horse, that rising star of the Collective of Plenty, the fierce, the brave, the one and only Varesa! Perhaps the record of 80 servings of Blazed Meat Stew she set has set the great Pacal's blood boiling!"

dialogues.speaker: "Weary Inn" Announcement
dialogues.text: "Rumors say that after taking the crown of Supremo in the Collective of Plenty's preliminary competition, she even joined in those of the other tribes, apparently just out of her sheer love of food..."

dialogues.speaker: "Weary Inn" Announcement
dialogues.text: "Just how will the legendary Pacal handle Varesa's assault? After all, she is the one who can take her time munching her way through our entire store's storehouse as though enjoying a post-meal dessert!"

dialogues.speaker: "Weary Inn" Announcement
dialogues.text: "In order for us to handle the challenge posed by these two 'Stomach Supremos' as well as the pressure brought to bear by the numerous other competitors, the Weary Inn will double and redouble our food reserves!"

dialogues.speaker: House Specialties
dialogues.text: "We'd like to specially recommend our Tatacos! Ask anyone in Natlan — these tasty treats are not to be missed!"

dialogues.speaker: House Specialties
dialogues.text: "This quick, convenient food is made with Grainfruit, Shrimp, Cheese, and Onions, and is the perfect calorie-packed pick-me-up to fuel you up!"

dialogues.speaker: House Specialties
dialogues.text: "Visitors from abroad should also try our Saurus Crackers — a snack beloved by both humans and Saurians! Milk and Xocoatl are the ultimate combination! Dunk 'em and dip 'em before eating!"

dialogues.speaker: Travel Guide
dialogues.text: "...Never forget to prepare a temporary yet comfy bed for your Saurian companion before camping or resting!"

dialogues.speaker: Travel Guide
dialogues.text: "First, find some dry branches and stones to build the foundation. Make sure it isn't too moist, otherwise the Saurian's sleep will be adversely affected."

dialogues.speaker: Travel Guide
dialogues.text: "Next, spread out some soft fabric and cloth on top of the foundation to form a comfortable bed."

dialogues.speaker: Travel Guide
dialogues.text: "Finally, stuff the bedding with fur or other items that can help retain heat as a filling, and cover the Saurian with a soft woven blanket, and you're done!"

dialogues.speaker: Travel Guide
dialogues.text: "For detailed setup instructions, please consult with our staff. We have extensive experience in caring for Saurian companions..."

dialogues.speaker: Guest's Message
dialogues.text: "I hit the jackpot!"

dialogues.speaker: Guest's Message
dialogues.text: "I think I'm staying in the same room that Chasca had during the last competition!"

dialogues.speaker: Guest's Message
dialogues.text: "Yep, that's THAT Chasca! The center of attention, the one who never fails, the indomitable Chasca! I'm gonna write this into my family history!"

dialogues.speaker: Weary Inn Response
dialogues.text: "Miss, we understand your excitement, but please do not roll around on the floor of your room..."

dialogues.speaker: Weary Inn Response
dialogues.text: "We wish you success in your adventures..."
